keyTransfer.description: Declared in the ack to a test message. Tells the registrar which keys it can send in create_tenant messages. Unknown values are ignored, and a list of only unknown values counts as not declared.

algorithms.description: The key algorithms the receiver imports. Defaults to ["SECP256K1"]. Keys of other algorithms are sent only as JWKs.

encodings.description: The encodings the receiver reads SECP256K1 keys in: "hex", "jwk" or both. Defaults to ["hex"].
